name: Lyo.Idempotency.AspNetCore
tagline: Idempotency middleware for controllers and minimal APIs. Place it after UseRouting.
description: UseIdempotency runs after routing so Endpoint.Metadata includes RequireIdempotencyKey on a controller, an action, or a minimal API. Safe methods ignore the header. The scope is api|{subject}|{method}|{path}. Subject is the lyo:user claim, otherwise sub.
features: **[RequireIdempotencyKey]** on a controller applies to every action. A marked endpoint with no header returns 400.
**Same key, different body is 409.** The hash is the raw query plus the raw body. Replay writes the stored status and Idempotency-Replayed: true.

examples.title: Controller and minimal API

sections.title: Headers
sections.body: The request headers are Idempotency-Key and X-Idempotency-Key. A missing subject with a present header returns 400 idempotency_subject_required. GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, and TRACE ignore the header.
